translations.web: You are righteous, Yahweh. Your judgments are upright.
translations.bsb: Righteous are You, O LORD, and upright are Your judgments.
translations.kjv: TZADDI. Righteous art thou, O LORD, and upright are thy judgments.
translations.asv: TSADHE. Righteous art thou, O Jehovah, And upright are thy judgments.
